newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds needs 108-00 foothold for gains.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds needs 108-00 foothold for gains.

text.p: June T-bonds must scale 108-00 to make further gains on Tuesday, but the opportunity for upward movement is linked to the progress of the September Eurodollar future, technical analysts said.
"If we can zone the area between 107-26 and 108-00 off, and hold through there for the day, we can start to get some levels on the upside," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
"But the September Eurodollar needs to get through 93.79 to give us something to work on," he added.
June T-bonds were 2/32 higher at 107-22 in automated trade.
